subject: RFQ PO-2026-4471 STR-ORD
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

please send us your best price for air freight Stuttgart (STR) to Chicago (ORD): 6 pieces of gear motors, 700 kg gross weight, 2.8 cbm, ready 27.11.2026, delivered to STR by our own truck. Cheapest option, EUR.

Please quote our purchase order reference PO-2026-4471 in your offer, otherwise our accounting cannot process it.

Best regards
Frank Maier
Purchasing
Schwaben Antriebe GmbH
